groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Also known as Agenda. Golang/Rust RaaS active since July 2022 and one of the most prolific leak sites of 2025–26; double extortion, with the operator controlling encryption modes. Today's 11 postings came in afternoon batches spanning five regions, with none carrying a description ("N/A" on Ransomware.live).
groups.countries: Mexico (4), Côte d'Ivoire, Germany, Philippines, Romania, Taiwan, United Kingdom, United States
groups.sectors: Energy & Utilities, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Other, Professional Services, Technology, Transportation

groups.name: Genesis
groups.profile: Tracked by Ransomware.live since 2025-10-21; emerging double-extortion group focused on small and mid-sized US organisations in healthcare, retail, financial services, legal and manufacturing. Posted nine victims within six minutes (21:56–22:02 UTC), each with a one-line company blurb.
groups.sectors: Construction, Financial Services, Healthcare, Professional Services, Real Estate

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: Emerged March 2023 with suspected ties to ex-Conti members; double extortion, Windows and ESXi lockers, frequent abuse of VPN appliances without MFA. Postings follow its usual "We will upload N GB of corporate data soon" template.

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: Also known as Storm-2697. RaaS that emerged mid-2025 offering affiliates a 90% share; Go-based locker for Windows, Linux, NAS and BSD; a compromised C2 server in 2026 reportedly exposed 1,570+ linked victims. Today's three postings appear only on RansomLook so far.

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: Tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-04-29; associated with a Go-based multi-purpose malware also sold as an infostealer/botnet. Postings are long-form and stress sensitive customer relationships (here, ITAR aerospace/defence claims).

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023; phishing and Cobalt Strike for access; sells stolen data in auction-style "lots".

groups.name: SilentRansomGroup
groups.profile: Also known as Luna Moth / Chatty Spider / UNC3753; a former Conti team running callback-phishing data-extortion (no encryption) against US law firms in particular. RansomLook tracks the same postings as "Leakeddata". Three further redacted "FULL DATA TIMER" entries posted today are excluded as masked.

groups.name: Emperador
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since 2026-08-12. Postings include scheduled publication dates, sample-file links and short negotiation deadlines; a repeat poster against Italian firms (see №68).

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since 2026-09-18 with no published tactics profile. Postings itemise datasets in detail and mark unpaid victims "NOT PAID — EXPOSED".

groups.name: Pear
groups.profile: "Pure Extraction And Ransom" — data-theft-only extortion team tracked since 2025-08-05 that brands itself a private, disciplined crew.

groups.name: RansomHouse
groups.profile: Double-extortion operation active since late 2021, attributed to "Jolly Scorpius"; 120+ organisations across healthcare, finance, transportation and government; recently moved to a dual-key encryption design.

groups.name: Wallstreet
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since 2026-06-26 with no published tactics profile.

groups.name: Whitearmor
groups.profile: New DLS tracked since 2026-10-20. Posts large datasets with structured company dossiers; in №68 it said it was not asking for a ransom.
